paths.path: ~/.config/Gearcoleco/config.ini (SDL_GetPrefPath("Geardome", "Gearcoleco"), so $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Gearcoleco/ when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set); imgui.ini alongside. Portable mode: a portable.ini beside the executable or the --portable flag keeps everything in the executable's directory instead. The guessed names Gearcoleco.cfg / gearcoleco.ini do NOT exist - the file is config.ini (mINI format, [General] Version gate rewrites outdated files back to defaults), verified back through release 1.5.5
evidence: source:platforms/shared/desktop/main.cpp --portable flag (Store configuration and user data beside the application) @ 8ad5f92

paths.path: Controller bindings live inside config.ini itself, no separate key file: [InputA]/[InputB] hold one SDL_Scancode integer per ColecoVision key (KeyLeft/KeyRight/KeyUp/KeyDown, KeyLeftButton/KeyRightButton, KeyBlue/KeyPurple, Key0..Key9, KeyAsterisk, KeyHash; InputA defaults = arrows + A/S/D/F + numpad 0-9,*,/; InputB = J/L/I/K cluster) plus SDL gamepad fields as integer button/axis indices (Gamepad, GamepadDirectional 0=dpad/1=stick, GamepadInvertX/Y, GamepadX/GamepadY, GamepadLeftButton/GamepadRightButton, GamepadBlue/GamepadPurple, Gamepad0..Gamepad9, GamepadAsterisk, GamepadHash); [Hotkeys] stores <Name>Scancode/<Name>Mod int pairs (SaveState Ctrl+S, LoadState Ctrl+L, SelectSlot1..5 Ctrl+1..5); [InputGamepadShortcuts1]/[InputGamepadShortcuts2] map hotkeys to gamepad buttons. ColecoVision key set (GC_Keys) = 12-key keypad 0-9 + * + # , 4 joystick directions, Left/Right buttons, Super Action Controller Blue/Purple buttons. The bundled platforms/shared/gamecontrollerdb.txt (SDL GUID mappings) is loaded from beside the executable at startup. Super Action Controller spinner via [Emulator] Spinner + SpinnerSensitivity (mouse wheel/roller modes)
evidence: source:platforms/shared/desktop/events.cpp input_poll_controller button_map {scancode, GC_Keys, gamepad button} table + dpad/stick directional handling @ 8ad5f92
source:src/definitions.h enum GC_Keys (Keypad_0..9, Asterisk, Hash, Key_Up/Right/Down/Left, Key_Left_Button/Key_Right_Button, Key_Blue/Key_Purple) @ 8ad5f92

paths.path: Battery/cartridge saves go to <ROM basename>.sav (extension of the cartridge path replaced with 'sav') in the directory chosen by [Emulator] SaveFilesDirOption: 0 = default config root (~/.config/Gearcoleco/), 1 = beside the ROM, 2 = custom [Emulator] SaveFilesPath; written at ROM load/reset/unload and exit. Only written when the active mapper exposes save data (SaveDataSize > 0)
paths.naming: <ROM filename with extension swapped to .sav>, e.g. /roms/venture.col -> venture.sav; no slot suffix, no header - raw mapper save data. ColecoVision Super Game Module games need no save file (SGM = emulated 32KB SGM RAM + AY-3-8910, no extra BIOS); ADAM is not emulated
evidence: source:src/GearcolecoCore.cpp SaveRam/LoadRam (path from szPath + cartridge filename, extension replaced with "sav") @ 8ad5f92

paths.path: Save states go to the directory chosen by [Emulator] SaveStatesDirOption (0 = default config root, 1 = beside the ROM, 2 = custom [Emulator] SaveStatesPath); .gst is NOT used - the extension is .state<slot>; each state embeds a screenshot shown in the slot UI; plus a 10-second rewind buffer ([Rewind] Enabled=true by default) held in RAM only
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.state<slot> with slots 1..5 only (config [Emulator] SaveSlot ranges 0..4 and the GUI adds 1 before calling SaveState/LoadState, so files are game.state1..game.state5); 'save as file' via the file dialog writes the exact chosen path (index -1 bypasses the suffix)
evidence: source:src/GearcolecoCore.cpp GetSaveStatePath (basename, replace 3 chars after last dot with "state", append slot index) @ 8ad5f92
source:platforms/shared/desktop/emu.cpp update_savestates_data loops i+1 over 5 slots via GetSaveStateHeader(i + 1, dir, ...) @ 8ad5f92

paths.path: ColecoVision BIOS ROM selected by [Emulator] BiosPath in config.ini (string, default empty; chosen via GUI file dialog and loaded once at GUI init) - any filename is accepted, but the file must be exactly 0x2000 = 8192 bytes (8KB) or it is rejected ('Incorrect BIOS size'); Gearcoleco performs NO checksum validation and patches byte 0x69 for region (0x3C NTSC / 0x32 PAL) after load. The BIOS is effectively required: without it RunToVBlank refuses to run and the screen shows the embedded blank kNoBiosImage. The libretro build of the same core looks up <system>/colecovision.rom with fallback <system>/coleco.rom; community-standard NTSC image is commonly cited as MD5 2c66f5911e5b42b8ebe1131fd33062ca (8192 bytes), unverified by the emulator itself. Super Game Module needs no extra BIOS file
evidence: source:platforms/shared/desktop/gui.cpp gui_init loads config_emulator.bios_path via emu_load_bios @ 8ad5f92
source:src/Memory.cpp LoadBios (size != 0x2000 rejected, no hash check; Reset patches m_pBios[0x69] 0x32 PAL / 0x3C NTSC) @ 8ad5f92
source:src/GearcolecoCore.cpp RunToVBlank returns before running when !IsBiosLoaded; src/no_bios.h kNoBiosImage placeholder @ 8ad5f92
source:platforms/libretro/libretro.cpp bios_path "colecovision.rom" fallback "coleco.rom", error 'BIOS not found: coleco.rom' @ 8ad5f92
docs:abdess.github.io/retrobios/emulators/gearcoleco (colecovision.rom/coleco.rom, 8192 bytes required, size-only validation, 0x69 region patch, no SGM BIOS)

gap:sources/firmware-rules.json has no standalone gearcoleco rule - only retroarch:fbneo:ColecoVision sourcing 'Coleco - ColecoVision (Gearcoleco).zip' for RetroArch cores, so a standalone Gearcoleco runtime would fail the firmware audit

linux.notes: All user data (config.ini, imgui.ini, default saves/states) sits in one SDL_GetPrefPath root, so a private XDG_CONFIG_HOME or --portable isolates it; native saves/states keep their configured or ROM-side locations.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\Geardome\Gearcoleco\config.ini (SDL_GetPrefPath("Geardome", "Gearcoleco") under the user's Roaming profile); imgui.ini alongside; portable.ini beside gearcoleco.exe or --portable keeps everything beside the executable
evidence: docs:github.com/drhelius/Gearcoleco#readme official Windows desktop x64 and ARM64 builds
